name: Street ball
description:
Competitive map

Kill the enemy team and score 4 goals against them. Stay in the center of the field to collect souls

Recommended to play with a maximum of 3 players per team. Torment Pulse interacts with the ball, so agree before the game whether everyone buys it or no one does.

How to host and join

1) Enable Dev Console in Settings
2.1) Join the map using the command: map streetball

name: pkfr_cobbletowers
description:
Lil' ol map I made for Deadlock movement. "pkfr" stands for ParKour Fast Regen, reflecting how it's designed for one air jump, one air dash, etc. to always be available for each time you hop into the air.

Map has lots of wall jumps. Remember that when you air dash or air jump, your wall jump will be refreshed and you can get full height with it again. Many jumps in this map utilize this.
